Title: Generally Available: On-Demand Backups for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server

Body.Content:
Now you can create physical snapshots of Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server based on your business needs. This new feature complements the scheduled automated backups offered by the service, while adding the flexibility to delete the on-demand backups. You can manage costs more effectively as you support your scheduled refresh activities.  


Learn more.
